name: pad_formatted_parts
declaration: unsafe fn pad_formatted_parts (& mut self , formatted : & numfmt :: Formatted < '_ >) -> Result
documentation:
Takes the formatted parts and applies the padding.

 Assumes that the caller already has rendered the parts with required precision,
 so that `self.precision` can be ignored.

 # Safety

 Any `numfmt::Part::Copy` parts in `formatted` must contain valid UTF-8.
rules: Any `numfmt::Part::Copy` parts in `formatted` must contain valid UTF-8 for `pad_formatted_parts` to be called safely.
